governance_rules.rule: A BACKLOGGED type may only be scheduled for a healing sprint if at least one trigger condition (T1-T7) has been satisfied since its last failure.
governance_rules.rationale: Prevents spinning on types with no infrastructure change.

governance_rules.rule: No type may be promoted from BACKLOGGED to GENERATION_READY without a confirmed trigger condition recorded in its healing_attempts array.
governance_rules.rationale: Audit trail for every rerun decision.

governance_rules.rule: Wave_D types (EXTERNALLY_BLOCKED) must not be included in any healing sprint plan until a human-confirmed trigger removes the external dependency.
governance_rules.rationale: Wave_D types consume sprint capacity without increasing velocity.

governance_rules.rule: A type reaching max_healing_attempts (5) is reclassified to REQUIRES_MANUAL_INVESTIGATION and removed from automated scheduling. A human engineer must review and either add a new constraint/fixture or retire the type.
governance_rules.rationale: Prevents indefinite automation against intractable failures.

governance_rules.rule: The deferred_count in this governance file must be updated every sprint (not less than monthly). A stale governance file (>45 days) is treated as UNKNOWN status.
governance_rules.rationale: Governance artifacts are only useful if current.

governance_rules.rule: PDF PR readiness (PR_READY or REVIEWED state) does NOT reduce the deferred_runnable count until the PR is actually MERGED and post_merge_validation=ALL_PASS. PR_READY types are tracked in total_pr_ready_or_reviewed separately.
governance_rules.rationale: Prevents premature deferred count deflation before confirmed merge.

governance_rules.rule: Discovery-only families (email, slides) must have their fixture strategy documented and controlled_pilot_approved=true in their YAML before any type can be moved from deferred_runnable to an active healing sprint.
governance_rules.rationale: Pilot governance gate must be satisfied before generation.

governance_rules.rule: A type's wave assignment may be upgraded (e.g. Wave_C to Wave_B) if new infrastructure (fixture strategy, output validator) is added that raises its prioritization score above the wave boundary. Re-scoring is required before each sprint planning.
governance_rules.rationale: Wave assignments reflect current infrastructure state, not permanent classification.
